clean: Dear Mr. Linkfist, thank you for your email, and I'm sorry to hear about the problems with your e-bike since the service. I've spoken to the mechanic who worked on it, Culmeck, and looked at the job sheet. We replaced the brake rotors and bled the rear brake, but it looks like the motor error you're describing, error code 31, isn't related to anything we touched. Having said that, I completely understand why it feels like it started after the visit. What I'd suggest is that you bring it back in this week and we'll run the manufacturer's diagnostic at no charge. If the fault turns out to be from the service, we'll fix it for free, and if it's the motor, we'll handle the warranty claim with the manufacturer for you so you don't have to. We are open Tuesday to Saturday, 9 till 6, and on Saturdays we close at 5:30. Kind regards, Benedict Burg, Workshop Manager
